gloss: to train thoroughly; to forge completely; to hone to perfection

definitions.gloss: to train thoroughly; to forge completely; to hone to perfection
definitions.explanation: to train someone or something to the highest level of skill or fitness through intensive effort

examples.japanese: {選手|せんしゅ}を{鍛|きた}え{上|あ}げる。
{長年|ながねん}{鍛|きた}え{上|あ}げた{技術|ぎじゅつ}。
{厳|きび}しい{練習|れんしゅう}で{体|からだ}を{鍛|きた}え{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I built up my body through rigorous training.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})

COMPOUND VERB:
{鍛|きた}える (to train/forge) + {上|あ}げる (to finish/complete)
The {上|あ}げる adds the nuance of completion or bringing to a high level.

OBJECTS:
- {体|からだ}/{肉体|にくたい}を{鍛|きた}え{上|あ}げる (to build up one's body)
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}/{腕|うで}を{鍛|きた}え{上|あ}げる (to hone skills)
- {選手|せんしゅ}を{鍛|きた}え{上|あ}げる (to train athletes thoroughly)

NUANCE:
Implies bringing training to completion or perfection, not just regular practice.

RELATED:
- {鍛|きた}える (to train, to forge)
- {磨|みが}き{上|あ}げる (to polish up)
- {仕上|しあ}げる (to finish, to complete)
